jobs.description: As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. jobs.description: We are seeking a Research Scientist to join our Data Analytics team. Data Analytics is an exciting and growing function, bringing together existing internal expertise with targeted external hiring. Our mission is to turn proprietary data into industry-leading insights on leadership —both to equip our client-facing teams and to generate high-impact intellectual capital. We are a small, collaborative, and intellectually curious team that works closely with colleagues across Technology, Marketing, and the firm’s client-facing practices. This role offers a unique opportunity to operate at the intersection of advanced statistical research, real-world leadership impact, and client engagement, within a firm with unparalleled access to senior decision-makers globally. This role is designed for someone with a strong interest in statistics, applied research, leadership, and business performance , and—critically—the ability to think rigorously about methodological approach. The Research Scientist is expected to frame researchable questions, develop and test hypotheses, and select and apply appropriate statistical approaches to address complex, business-critical leadership and governance questions. This includes determining how a question should be answered—not only what to analyze—by drawing on approaches such as regression frameworks, quasi-experimental designs, survival or event-history analysis, latent-variable models, or Bayesian methods, depending on the research objective and data structure. In addition to delivering rigorous research, the role requires the ability to translate analytical work into tangible client impact —through advisory support, live client interactions, analytics demonstrations, and proof-of-value work that helps position analytics as a differentiating capability. We explore questions such as: what characteristics make some leaders more successful than others? How do contextual conditions shape leadership risk and performance over time? How do culture, governance, and leadership interact to influence organizational outcomes? In this role, your primary focus will be to: Design and support hypothesis-driven statistical research , including the formulation of testable hypotheses, definition of identification strategies, and critical evaluation of assumptions (e.g., causal vs. non-causal inference). Apply advanced statistical methodologies —including regression and generalized linear models, quasi-experimental methods (e.g., matching, difference-in-differences), survival and time-to-event analysis, latent-variable approaches, and Bayesian frameworks—to guide model selection, validation, robustness testing, and interpretation. Translate analytical findings into clear, executive-ready narratives , producing research memos, client-facing materials, and thought-leadership content that connect methodology and evidence to insight. Partner closely with the Lead Data Scientist to design, execute, validate, and document rigorous quantitative analyses aligned with high research standards. Actively participate in client-facing analytical work , supporting consultants in live engagements where data and insight strengthen leadership advisory. Deliver or co-deliver analytics demonstrations , showing how data and analytical tools can address client needs. Design and support Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and Proof-of-Value exercises, tailored to client-specific challenges and strategic questions. Help translate analytical capabilities into compelling value propositions , supporting early-stage client conversations and contributing to the origination of analytics-related opportunities. LOCATION Like the rest of the firm, the Data Analytics team works globally, with professionals located in Amsterdam and in the United States. Our strong preference is for a colleague to join our Amsterdam office. KEY RELATIONSHIPS Reports to: Lead Data Scientist, Data Analytics (Amsterdam) Other key relationships: Head of Data Analytics Data Analytics team members/colleagues Industry/Function Practice Directors Marketing and other internal stakeholders (Operations, Finance, etc.) Data Engineering / Technology partners (as needed for research enablement) Client-facing Consultants and Practice Teams Business development / proposal stakeholders, as relevant to analytics-led opportunities KEY RESPONSABILITIES Research Design and Methodological Rigor Support the design and execution of proprietary research projects on leadership, governance, culture, and performance. Apply appropriate statistical methodologies under guidance (e.g., regression frameworks, causal and quasi-experimental approaches, time-to-event/survival analysis, Bayesian approaches, latent-structure methods). Contribute to the development, documentation, and stress-testing of internal analytical frameworks, metrics, and indices. Conduct diagnostics, robustness checks, and sensitivity analyses to ensure analytical credibility. Insight Generation and Executive Storytelling Translate statistical findings into clear narratives suitable for senior, non-technical audiences. Draft or co-author internal research memos, client-facing exhibits, and thought-leadership content (e.g., articles, briefing notes, presentation storylines). Support the synthesis of results into executive summaries and high-stakes presentation materials. Client-Facing Analytics & Pre-Sales Contribution Support client engagements where analytics enhances leadership dialogue. Deliver or contribute to analytics demonstrations, showcasing capabilities and insights. Design and support Proofs of Concept (PoCs) and Proof-of-Value exercises addressing client-specific challenges. Partner with consultants to tailor analytical outputs to client contexts and decision needs. Contribute to the development of repeatable analytics offerings and scalable solutions. Support revenue generation efforts, helping position analytics in opportunity development while not owning commercial targets directly. Data Usage (Non‑Engineering Focus) Work with curated datasets extracted from the firm’s cloud-based data platforms and research repositories. Identify data limitations, assumptions, and risks relevant to statistical analysis; escalate quality issues where needed. Collaborate with data quality and engineering colleagues while not owning platform development, pipelines, or production systems. Analytical Tooling and Libraries Conduct analysis primarily in Python/SPSS, within a research‑oriented statistical environment that supports exploratory, inferential, and hypothesis‑driven work. Apply tooling appropriate for data manipulation, econometric and regression‑based modeling, quasi‑experimental analysis, survival and event‑history modeling, distributional and diagnostic analysis, and selected unsupervised or latent‑structure methods. Produce clear exploratory and presentation‑ready visualizations to support interpretation and executive‑level storytelling. Emphasize reproducible, well‑documented workflows, aligned with academic and high‑end applied research standards. IDEAL EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Data Science, Quantitative Social Science , or a related field; an advanced degree ( Master’s or PhD ) is strongly preferred. jobs.description: As AI agents take on more autonomous actions on behalf of users, a critical question emerges: how do you ensure every one of those actions is authorized, auditable, and safe? That is the problem you will help solve on the Amazon Quick access-control team. As a Software Development Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the authorization policies, enforcement plane, and audit systems that govern every interaction in Amazon Quick, whether initiated by a person or by an AI agent acting on their behalf. Your work will directly enable Amazon Quick to scale its agentic capabilities while meeting the access-control requirements that enterprise customers depend on. You will collaborate across more than a dozen partner teams, influence architectural decisions in systems you depend on, and coach other engineers on your team. This is an opportunity to shape how the industry approaches access control for agentic AI, at a time when the problem is still being defined. Key job responsibilities - Design and implement authorization policies, enforcement mechanisms, and audit pipelines that ensure every human and agent interaction in Amazon Quick is governed by a correct, enforceable access decision. - Lead the architecture of distributed access-control systems, balancing scalability, security, and maintainability while identifying and resolving risks before they reach production. - Collaborate with partner teams across the Amazon Quick organization to align on integration points, define service contracts, and ensure access controls keep pace with new agentic capabilities. - Evaluate and integrate generative AI tooling into development workflows where it accelerates delivery, and apply responsible practices when reviewing AI-generated outputs. - Mentor and grow engineers on the team through code reviews, design guidance, and technical coaching, raising the quality bar for the team's software practices. A day in the life You might start the morning reviewing an access-policy change proposed by a partner team, verifying it meets audit requirements before it rolls out. After a design review with your team, you spend focused time prototyping a new enforcement mechanism that handles delegated agent permissions. In the afternoon you pair with a teammate to debug an edge case in the audit pipeline, then wrap up by writing a short design document that captures the trade-offs you explored. Your work spans both solo deep-thinking time and collaborative sessions with engineers across the Amazon Quick organization. About the team Our team owns the authorization and access-control layer for Amazon Quick, making sure the product is enterprise-ready for the world's largest organizations. We partner with teams across the full Amazon Quick organization, over 1,000 engineers, giving you broad visibility into how the product evolves. As agentic AI grows more capable, the access-control challenges we tackle are new and still being defined across the industry, so you will have real influence over the direction we take. If you are energized by security-critical problems at scale and want to work where AI meets enterprise trust, this is the team for you.

About the Team
DoorDash's Protective Services function safeguards executives, their families, and residences through executive protection, residential security, threat management, and secure transportation across a three-brand global enterprise. The team operates 24/7 and is built on the principle that protection starts before an incident, not after. The people who do this work well combine operational discipline with personal composure, take ownership of outcomes rather than tasks, and represent the program in every interaction with the principal population.
About the Role
The Protective Services Agent provides close protection for DoorDash executives and their families across all operating environments, including corporate headquarters, domestic and international travel, company events, and residential settings. The role requires a trained executive protection professional who develops and implements security plans, conducts advances and risk assessments, coordinates with law enforcement and venue partners, and serves as the principal's primary security presence. Personnel must be capable of managing incidents and serving as first responders on scene. Operations regularly involve extended duty periods, irregular schedules, and short-notice deployments. Potential travel up to 25% of the time.

Provide close protection across all principal environments.
Serve as the primary security presence for executives and their families across headquarters, travel, events, and residential operations. Maintain continuous situational awareness, assess threats in real time, and execute protective protocols effectively and unobtrusively.
Plan and execute security operations.
Develop and implement comprehensive security plans for executive movements and events, incorporating site surveys, route planning, risk assessments, staffing requirements, screening procedures, and emergency response strategies. Conduct advances for all principal movements and update plans in response to changes in schedule, environment, or threat landscape.
Manage travel security end-to-end.
Plan and execute security logistics for domestic and international executive travel, including itinerary management, secure ground transportation, hotel and venue assessments, and coordination with in-country security partners and law enforcement. Identify and communicate travel-related security concerns to program leadership before each trip.
Respond to incidents and serve as first responder.
Serve as the primary security responder for all incidents during executive operations, including security events and medical emergencies. Manage situations while maintaining overall operational continuity and ensuring program leadership maintains awareness of all significant events.
Maintain operational readiness.
Own vehicle readiness, equipment management, communications tools, and all operational documentation to the standard required for continuous protective operations. Prepare detailed after-action reports and contribute to the ongoing development and improvement of standard operating procedures.
We are excited about you because you bring…
Executive protection experience.
Three to five years in executive protection, corporate security, law enforcement, or military service with direct application to close protection operations supporting senior leaders. Proven ability to conduct advances, develop security plans, manage logistics, and provide close protection across headquarters, travel, and event environments in a corporate setting.
Security planning and risk assessment.
Demonstrated ability to develop comprehensive security plans, conduct threat and risk assessments, and produce written documentation suitable for program leadership review. Judgment under pressure.
A track record of making sound, time-sensitive decisions in dynamic environments. The ability to manage incidents, prioritize competing demands, and maintain operational continuity without requiring direction on the basics.
Corporate professionalism and discretion.
Experience operating in a corporate environment with a clear understanding of business etiquette, executive-level interaction, and confidentiality. Trusted to manage sensitive information about principals, their families, and their schedules across all operating environments.
Communications and documentation.
Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact with internal leadership, executive assistants, law enforcement, and external partners. Able to produce clear professional reports, security plans, and after-action documentation that meet the standard of a program that briefs senior leadership.
Physical readiness for the work.
The ability to stay on your feet and moving for long stretches across offices, residences, venues, and transit; to lift and carry equipment and supplies up to 50 lbs regularly and to assist or move a person to safety when required; to operate effectively in vehicles for extended periods; to see and assess people, vehicles, and conditions at distance and in variable light; to communicate clearly in loud and crowded environments; and to drive safely in heavy traffic and adverse conditions.
Endurance for the conditions.
The ability to work outdoors and in transit across variable conditions including heat, cold, inclement weather, and crowds for as long as the work requires; to sustain performance during irregular schedules, extended duty periods, and on-call availability outside scheduled hours; and to keep making sound decisions while doing it.
Credentials.
Valid California driver's license with a clean driving record required. Advanced first aid and CPR certification required or must be obtained within 90 days of hire.
